title: World Championship Decks 2004: card flavor text

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: An artificial metal plane of four suns.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Warlord of Ish Sah commanding countless nim.

entities.name: Janus
entities.description: Speaker of the synod of the vedalken.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Being whose transmissions are his word; metal bows to him.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: A figure who had only to imagine ruin for Akroma to enact it.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: Angel who makes Ixidor's imagined ruin real.

entities.name: Grakk
entities.description: A creature who felt warm and fuzzy for the first time.

entities.name: Raksha Golden Cub
entities.description: Destined leader of the leonin prides.

entities.name: Darksteel Citadel
entities.description: Forge of the Darksteel Eye, home of Mirrodin's keeper.

entities.name: Kuldotha
entities.description: Wellspring of molten metal and temple of the goblin horde.

events.summary: Janus laments the murder of an idea.
events.quote: Murder of the living is tragic, but murder of the idea is unforgivable.

events.summary: Akroma enacts the ruin Ixidor imagines.
events.quote: Ixidor had only to imagine their ruin and Akroma made it so.

events.summary: Grakk feels warm and fuzzy for the first time.
events.quote: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.
If I wanted your opinion, I'd have told you what it was.

relations.note: warlord commanding countless nim from Ish Sah
relations.quote: Ish Sah, den of the warlord Geth, commander of countless nim.

relations.note: his transmissions are obeyed by metal
relations.quote: Its transmissions are the word of Memnarch.
